source: Product copy, Sep 2026: turn one-word descriptions into sentences, and fill the empty ones.
notes: Dry run first:  GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/path/key.json npx tsx scripts/import-catalogue.ts docs/ops/fixups/2026-09-descriptions.json --prod --dry-run
Drop --dry-run to write. Only the fields present here are touched.
Name / Master Category / Selling Price / MRP are echoed back from the live values because the importer requires them on every row - they change nothing.

Listing Status and Image URL are deliberately ABSENT. Most of these are Drafts awaiting photography; sending a status would either publish an unphotographed product or, for an Active row with no Image URL, silently demote it to Draft.

Copy is grounded only in each product's own record - the garment type and colour in its name or existing description, plus its category. Fabric and technique are claimed only where the record names them (Banarasi, Denim, Leather, Sequin); nothing else is asserted.

14 products are NOT in this file because their record says nothing to describe: twelve named only 'DESIGNER WEAR', one 'WESTERN WEAR', and one literally named 'test'. Twelve different descriptions for twelve identically-named products would be fiction. Give them real names and the copy follows.
